title: THE THEME
text: The theme is Trade-off. The first question: what could a game trade away that only this theme would ask for?

title: THE IDEA
text: A survivor game where the upgrade shop is the game's own Settings menu. Every power costs a piece of the game.

title: PLAIN SHAPES FIRST
text: The core loop built with coloured squares: move, collect light, open the menu, sell. It had to be fun before anything was added to it.

title: THE DESIGN
text: The rules, the numbers, the shop, the story and the finale, designed and written down before the game grew around the core.

title: THE LOOK
text: Last Light: 20 colours, 320 by 180 pixels, one low sun. The island, Wick and the six enemies of the dark.

title: THE SOUND
text: An original gothic score in D minor that builds across a run, and soft foley pitched into its key.

title: PLAY, DEBUG, TUNE
text: Whole runs played start to finish, bugs found and fixed, and the difficulty and pacing tuned until a run lands at about six and a half minutes.

title: SUNSET
text: A web build at the game's own 16:9, this site, and downloads for Mac, Windows and Linux.
